_note: All game tuning numbers live here (CLAUDE.md). Arrays marked 'by day' are indexed from day 1; days past the end reuse the last entry.
_maxActive: by day: most customers in line or waiting at once. A new one only comes once someone is served (after afterServeSec).

fry._note: Temperatures in °F. Doneness: 0 = raw dough, 1 = golden, ~1.5+ = dark.

glaze._note: Coordinates are normalised to the donut (centre 0,0, edges ±1). Base coat: coverage/goodCoverage × (1 − spill/spillZeroAt). Drizzle: right amount × spread over the 8 balls × (1 − spill/spillZeroAt). Wrong glaze × wrongGlazeFactor.

toppings._note: Pieces are placed in normalised donut coordinates. Per wanted topping: amount (menu topping.amount, too much is 0 at max × tooMuchZeroAtFactor) × evenness over the 8 balls × (1 − share that fell off / messZeroAt). Each unwanted topping multiplies by unwantedFactor.

box._note: Each ordered slot holding its flavour = 1, that flavour in the wrong slot = wrongSpotCredit, minus extraPenalty per extra donut.
